trade_setups.thesis: Friday's breadth-breakdown thesis confirmed by Monday gap-down. Russell -1.1% in first hour, no defensive bid. Highest-conviction setup of the three — trigger already armed, now in motion.

VIX broke through 19 on Monday open after closing Friday at 18.43. Term structure flattening. Tactical long-vol via VIXY captures continued risk-off path of least resistance. Cleaner expression than equity shorts because it doesn't need a specific level.
Carried forward — only sector green Friday, WTI holding $100. Pull-back to $58 zone gives entry on the rare risk-on hide-out. Energy decoupling from broad tape is the cleanest long expression.

bear_case: Counter-argument: a Monday gap-down following a Friday flush is the textbook 'second leg' setup that bottoms intraday and reverses by Tuesday. Capitulation entries are explicitly defined ahead — SPX 7,300 or VIX >22 — and Monday's open at 7,348 with VIX 19 is neither yet. Treating an unfinished move as confirmation risks selling the low. The DXY is still only at 99.45 (not the 100+ that signals genuine USD-flight panic), and the 10Y at 4.62% is up just 2bps overnight, suggesting bonds are starting to catch a defensive bid — that's a stabilization signal, not crisis. Invalidation level: if SPX reclaims 7,460 by Tuesday's close AND VIX prints below 17, the high-conviction step-aside call should be downgraded to HOLD.
